question: Should OpenClaw establish a stable, durable AI-safety telemetry and external-plugin emission contract now, including retention, privacy filtering, and operator query access, or keep the work behind narrower internal/exporter-only seams?
rationale: The choice changes the public plugin SDK, plugin manifest schema, persisted state, and operator-facing Gateway/CLI/UI behavior; code review cannot safely choose the permanent product and privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow stable contract
options.body: Define the allowed event fields, redaction/retention policy, trusted versus external provenance, and supported query/export surfaces before this API lands.

options.title: Land internal-only telemetry first
options.body: Keep the taxonomy and trusted core/exporter wiring private to core while deferring the external plugin manifest capability and durable operator UI until separately designed.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the canonical request open until security and product owners sponsor a scoped design with a concrete operator need.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow stable contract
recommendation.body: Define the allowed event fields, redaction/retention policy, trusted versus external provenance, and supported query/export surfaces before this API lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the affected public service-context and SDK boundary, while the decision also needs security/product sponsorship.
